about_the_game:
Escape the desert.

Find yourself.

Save your soul.

Be at one with the cycle of all things.

The clock is ticking, even though there is no clock.  Because there is no time.  But the end will come when your health reaches zero.  You have just enough time to reach the next exit, the next challenge.  When will the maze end?

Will you race through quickly, or dare to explore and find the secrets that await?

At what expense will you learn these secrets?  Will you learn something?

Only you and your alien space bunny can answer that.

Dorsaka is a fresh port from an original game that was made back in 2013 using Stencyl.  The removal of Flash support from the modern internet means that the original Dorsaka can't be played, not without jumping through some hoops.  Dorsaka was strangely popular with over 7,000 plays.  Which isn't too bad for a game created for a game jam.  Now it returns, using the hot freshness of the Godot engine and powered by the relentless pestering of a million voices demanding the return of the game no one was talking about.

short_description: A strange exploration game with an ever decreasing health bar. Take control of your weird alien space bunny and traverse a set of inter-linked mazes in a quest to escape a desert that may or may not exist in multiple dimensions within your own mind. Manage your health, find secrets, escape the maze
